id: title:Gilbert09:retry a vtgate dial timeout hit during metadata discovery

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion resilience against transient Vitess/TiProxy failures
review.reason: Adds transient error detection and retry support for Vitess dial timeouts and TiProxy unavailability, allowing warehouse ingestion to recover from transient failures rather than failing immediately. P1.F1.H3 adds the helper and condition; P1.F2.H1 contains only a test assertion and no relevant implementation.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on supplied hunk observations; no independent verification of actual production recovery or adoption. Tier 2 assigned because implementation and relevant checks are visible, but broader systemic impact or unverified outcomes remain unobserved.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No score assigned yet.

observations.behavior: Clarified the comment distinguishing Vitess/PlanetScale dial-timeout errors from bare MySQL errors, and updated the comment to note that this error can occur both at connect time and on the first query against an open connection.
observations.code_quote: # A vtgate dial timeout to a backend tablet (error 1815) can land on a metadata query
observations.posthog_connection: This change documents and supports the retry behavior for a specific transient error class in warehouse ingestion, potentially reducing false-positive failures during warehouse setup or metadata refresh.

observations.behavior: Added a new condition to the transient error check, including a new helper function `_is_transient_vitess_dial_timeout` and `_is_transient_tiproxy_unavailable`.
observations.posthog_connection: This extends the transient error detection and retry mechanism to cover Vitess dial timeouts and TiProxy unavailability, allowing the warehouse ingestion system to recover from these transient failures rather than failing immediately.

observations.behavior: Updated the comment for `_retry_on_transient_tablet_unavailable` to include a dial-timeout reaching a backend tablet, a TiProxy failover, or a plain peer-reset connection drop as self-healing conditions.
observations.posthog_connection: This hunk does not contain the relevant code change; it only contains the test assertion. The relevant code change is in P1.F1.H3.
